title: Lebesgue–Besicovitch differentiation along open balls for a finite Borel measure on ℝ^N (normalAverage μ f x → f(x) μ-a.e.)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let μ be a finite Borel measure on ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) (μ(ℝ^N) < ∞), and let f : ℝ^N → ℝ^N be μ-integrable. Then for μ-almost every x ∈ ℝ^N, normalAverage μ f x ρ := μ(B_ρ(x)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫_{B_ρ(x)} f dμ converges to f(x) as ρ ↓ 0. Here B_ρ(x) is the open ball, t.toReal is the real value of t ∈ [0, ∞], and 0⁻¹ = 0, so the average is 0 when μ(B_ρ(x)) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn N), IsFiniteMeasure μ → Integrable f μ → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (normalAverage μ f x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (f x))
